commands.summary: Plan and execute the cancel signature request reverse-ETL action

flags.name: signature_request_id
flags.summary: Required signature request id record field.

examples: pm dropbox-sign cancel signature request apply --plan <plan-name>
commands.risk: destructive external mutation; cancels an incomplete signature request, this action is not reversible; approval required
commands.approval: requires plan, preview, approval, and execute

commands.summary: Plan and execute the create team reverse-ETL action
examples: pm dropbox-sign create team apply --plan <plan-name>
commands.risk: external mutation; creates a new Team and makes the calling account its member; fails if the caller already belongs to a Team
commands.approval: requires plan, preview, approval, and execute

commands.summary: Plan and execute the delete template reverse-ETL action
examples: pm dropbox-sign delete template apply --plan <plan-name>
commands.risk: destructive external mutation; completely deletes a template from the account, this action is not reversible; approval required
commands.approval: requires plan, preview, approval, and execute

commands.summary: Plan and execute the release hold signature request reverse-ETL action

flags.name: signature_request_id
flags.summary: Required signature request id record field.

examples: pm dropbox-sign release hold signature request apply --plan <plan-name>
commands.risk: external mutation; releases a held signature request created from an UnclaimedDraft, immediately sending requests to all signers; approval required
commands.approval: requires plan, preview, approval, and execute

commands.summary: Plan and execute the remind signature request reverse-ETL action

flags.name: signature_request_id
flags.summary: Required signature request id record field.

examples: pm dropbox-sign remind signature request apply --plan <plan-name>
commands.risk: external mutation; sends an email reminder to a signer; cannot be sent again within 1 hour of the last reminder (manual or automatic)
commands.approval: requires plan, preview, approval, and execute

commands.summary: Plan and execute the remove signature request reverse-ETL action

flags.name: signature_request_id
flags.summary: Required signature request id record field.

examples: pm dropbox-sign remove signature request apply --plan <plan-name>
commands.risk: destructive external mutation; removes the caller's access to a completed signature request from the account's list view, this action is not reversible; approval required
commands.approval: requires plan, preview, approval, and execute

commands.summary: Plan and execute the remove team member reverse-ETL action
examples: pm dropbox-sign remove team member apply --plan <plan-name>
commands.risk: destructive external mutation; removes a user from the caller's Team; optionally transfers the removed account's documents to another account (Enterprise plans only), which is not reversible; approval required
commands.approval: requires plan, preview, approval, and execute

commands.summary: Plan and execute the remove template user reverse-ETL action
examples: pm dropbox-sign remove template user apply --plan <plan-name>
commands.risk: external mutation; revokes the specified account's access to a template
commands.approval: requires plan, preview, approval, and execute

commands.summary: Run the signature requests ETL stream
examples: pm dropbox-sign signature requests list --json

commands.summary: Run the team members ETL stream
examples: pm dropbox-sign team members list --json
pm dropbox-sign templates list --json

commands.summary: Plan and execute the update account reverse-ETL action
examples: pm dropbox-sign update account apply --plan <plan-name>
commands.risk: external mutation; updates the caller's account settings (currently limited to the event callback URL and locale)
commands.approval: requires plan, preview, approval, and execute

commands.summary: Plan and execute the update signature request reverse-ETL action

flags.name: signature_request_id
flags.summary: Required signature request id record field.

examples: pm dropbox-sign update signature request apply --plan <plan-name>
commands.risk: external mutation; changes a signer's email address or name on an in-progress signature request, redirecting where the next request/reminder is delivered; approval required
commands.approval: requires plan, preview, approval, and execute

commands.summary: Plan and execute the update team reverse-ETL action
examples: pm dropbox-sign update team apply --plan <plan-name>
commands.risk: external mutation; renames the caller's own Team
commands.approval: requires plan, preview, approval, and execute
